description: This file provides a utility function `inferColumns` used to generate column configurations for a DataTable component based on provided data rows, an allowlist of fields, and options such as date fields. It helps in dynamically creating table structures based on the data content.

methods.name: inferColumns(rows = [], allowlist = [], options = {})
methods.description: Generates an array of column configurations for a DataTable based on data rows, allowlist, and options. It filters fields based on data presence and allowlist, formats labels, and handles date fields with custom rendering.
